description: Creates a new lead search («поиск лидов») from the onboarding answers and starts compiling its requirements (~1-2 minutes; nothing is charged in credits, but it spends the onboarding's brief if no assistant did). Then poll get_search every 20-30 s until status is `ready`, review the spec with the user (get_search detail=spec), and only then quote and run it. company and icp are required. [REST: POST /api/tasks]

exclude_companies.description: Also leave out the companies of those people.

exclude_scope.description: From those searches: everyone analysed (all) or only leads.

exclude_tasks.description: Earlier searches whose people to leave out.

exclude_urls.description: LinkedIn profile links of people to leave out.

icp.description: Whom to find: the customer profile (step 3).

language.description: Language of the outreach messages (default english).

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

source_task.description: The earlier onboarding this one was filled from (get_onboarding_prefill).

name: create_search
title: Create a lead search
